name: Lint
outputs: format, vet and proto lint results
desc: Checks Go formatting, vet and Buf lint. A quality gate is not a signature.

name: Test
desc: Runs repository tests. Actual run results remain separate evidence.

name: TestRace
desc: Runs Go tests with the race detector.

name: Security
outputs: raw govulncheck and gosec findings plus admission result
desc: Preserves raw findings and enforces policy. Scanner errors and unapproved findings block admission.

name: ProtoCheck
inputs: pinned proto contracts and generated code
desc: Regenerates the contract and fails when committed generated code differs.

name: SpecRegistryCheck
desc: Checks pinned OSCAL assets against the schema registry. Drift prevents acceptance.

name: Build
desc: Compiles the server. Build configuration alone supplies no signing claim.

name: Coverage
desc: Collects coverage from actual tests. A report does not establish a universal coverage threshold.

name: SBOM
desc: Inventories the built binary with Syft. Validation and signed manifest coverage are separate gates.

name: SBOM Validation
inputs: actual binary and image SBOMs, versioned exception policy
outputs: raw validation findings and OSCAL assessment-results
desc: Checks NTIA minimum elements. Findings require explicit valid exceptions; report existence is insufficient.

name: Image
desc: Exports image bytes for analysis before consumer publication. Server gRPC is :50051; metrics are :9090.

name: SDK Sources and Packages
inputs: pinned proto contracts and language build metadata
outputs: six source ZIPs, supported language packages and consumer results
desc: Builds six compatibility ZIPs plus a Go module, Python wheel/sdist, Java JAR/POM, NuGet package, Node ESM/CJS package, and Swift SPM protobuf models. Swift supplies no generated RPC client. Clean consumer tests and verified manifest coverage gate download eligibility.

name: OpenAPI
inputs: OSCAL, governance, transparency exchange and graph contracts
desc: Merges deterministic service specifications and rejects missing operations, empty paths and invalid references.

name: OSCAL Frameworks
outputs: 35 catalog JSON files and the PBMM profile
desc: Generates and validates catalogs plus the profile. Every artifact carries a producer and OSCAL touchpoint.

name: Site Preview
outputs: static local preview with local Scalar assets
desc: Renders an incomplete local preview. Missing hosted proof keeps downloads ineligible; JavaScript cannot grant eligibility.

name: Serve
desc: Serves a local preview for browser checks. It does not promote a release or establish hosted verification.

name: All
desc: Runs repository lint, tests, race, security, contract drift and schema validation. Every mandatory gate must pass.

name: Release Archives
outputs: GoReleaser archives, checksums and archive SBOMs
desc: Runs GoReleaser with publish, announce and sign skipped. Archives stay staged until hosted proof and promotion gates succeed.

name: Release Candidate
inputs: pinned tagged source and analysis policy
outputs: complete payload and initial payload manifest
desc: Dagger packages six SDKs, 35 catalogs, PBMM profile, platform archives, multi-architecture OCI archive, API assets and enforced analysis. No public release or image tag is created here.

name: Finalize Candidate
inputs: candidate payload and hosted payload attestation
outputs: rendered final site bytes and final release-manifest.json
desc: Dagger verifies expected repository, workflow, source SHA and tag for exact payload bytes before rendering eligible release HTML. It then covers every final payload and site byte in a non-self-referential manifest.

name: Verify Candidate
inputs: unchanged final bytes and hosted final manifest attestation
desc: Dagger verifies the final manifest identity and all covered digests before any promotion. Any missing, tampered or unverified mandatory object fails. Detached proof envelopes never hash themselves.

name: Snapshot
desc: Stages development archives with no publication or signing. Snapshot output is not a verified release.
